description: Rail Safeguarding Lines is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Areas where the railway will be shallow, at or above ground level.They may also include land required permanently for stations, ventilation and access shafts. Here all planning applications must be referred to Crossrail. Property owners within the zone who would feel adversely affected can serve government with Statutory Blight notice. Coverage: Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The portal files it under the publisher Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Its tags are land use. The portal shows 2023-12-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
